items.name: font-weight
items.title: Font weight
items.description: Geist variable-font weight tokens for animated font-weight transitions.

items.name: springs
items.title: Springs
items.description: Three-tier spring/tween motion tokens — fast, moderate, slow.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn() class merger, extended with the custom text-* font-size scale from globals.css so tailwind-merge doesn't drop it.

items.name: use-merge-split
items.title: useMergeSplit
items.description: Groups a checked-item list's contiguous rows into runs and reports one spring-animated background block per run, so adjacent selections read as one continuous shape that merges and splits instead of separate highlighted rows.

items.name: use-proximity-hover
items.title: useProximityHover
items.description: Tracks cursor distance across a list of items to preview the nearest one before it's clicked.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Collapsible accordion with spring-animated height and chevron, and proximity hover across every row.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Base UI button with variant and size styling via class-variance-authority.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Base UI checkbox with a hand-drawn checkmark that draws on and off.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox Group
items.description: A multi-select list of Base UI checkboxes with proximity hover across every row and a merge/split background that reads contiguous checked rows as one continuous block.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Base UI combobox — a text input filtered against a list as you type.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click menu — Base UI's Menu popup anchored at the pointer.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Centered modal with a spring-scaled popup and fading backdrop.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Edge-anchored panel with real drag-to-dismiss on top/bottom, vaul-style release physics.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Base UI menu with submenus, checkbox/radio items, and a spring-driven popup.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: App-shell top menu — a row of dropdown Menus with macOS-style hover switching.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Mega-menu nav with a shared viewport that resizes between preview panels.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored floating panel that grows out of its trigger, scaling from Base UI's transform-origin.

items.name: preview-card
items.title: Preview Card
items.description: A floating preview panel that opens on a longer hover delay than Tooltip.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Base UI radio group with a spring-driven selected background and proximity hover across every row.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Base UI select with a spring-driven popup, a sliding selected-row highlight, and a checkmark that draws itself in.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Base UI slider with a spring-driven thumb — direct 1:1 tracking while dragging, a spring settle on release or track-press, and a delayed hover tooltip. Supports single-value and two-thumb range use out of the box.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Base UI switch with a squishy, draggable, spring-driven thumb.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tab list with a spring-driven sliding indicator and proximity hover across every tab.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Base UI two-state button — a favorite/star button, a toolbar formatting control.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row of linked Base UI Toggles — single-select segmented control with a sliding indicator, or independent multi-select.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Fast, fading label that slides in from the trigger's side.
